frontmatter.name: pr-to-video
frontmatter.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

frontmatter.name: product-launch-video
frontmatter.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

frontmatter.name: faceless-explainer
frontmatter.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

frontmatter.name: svg-path-draw
frontmatter.description: Animate SVG paths drawing progressively using stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset.

frontmatter.name: svg-icon-enrichment
frontmatter.description: Animate internal SVG elements (rotating hands, opening blades, pulsing dots, dash flows) to make icons feel alive without replacing them.

frontmatter.name: ai-tracking-box
frontmatter.description: Animated bounding box with L-shaped corner markers following an oscillating path — simulates AI object detection / tracking.

frontmatter.name: cursor-click-ripple
frontmatter.description: Animated mouse cursor moves to target, clicks with scale depression and expanding ripple rings.

frontmatter.name: dynamic-content-sequencing
frontmatter.description: Auto-calculate timeline start/end times from content length + per-item duration config — longer content gets more screen time without hardcoded numbers.

frontmatter.name: avatar-cloud-network
frontmatter.description: Avatars distributed on an elliptical ring connected by SVG dashed lines to a center hub — social proof "community" reveal with staggered entry.

frontmatter.name: sine-wave-loop
frontmatter.description: Bounded sine-driven idle — subtle jitter or a single genuinely-needed bounded ambient breath on a held element. De-emphasized: circular breathing as "aliveness" is cheap; prefer sequential reveal timed to the VO, then subtle jitter, before reaching here.

frontmatter.name: hacker-flip-3d
frontmatter.description: Character-level 3D rotation with random glyph substitution for a decryption reveal effect.

frontmatter.name: card-morph-anchor
frontmatter.description: Container morphs dimensions and border-radius between shots, serving as a visual transition anchor.

frontmatter.name: scale-swap-transition
frontmatter.description: Coordinated shrink-out + spring pop-in morph-like transition between two elements — no SVG path interpolation needed.

frontmatter.name: counting-dynamic-scale
frontmatter.description: Counter animation where the value counts up while transform scale grows to its final size, creating escalating visual weight without per-frame text reflow.

frontmatter.name: physics-press-reaction
frontmatter.description: Cursor + element synchronized press via subtractive spring forces — cursor lands on element, both compress together, then release. Distinct from press-release-spring (which has no cursor).

frontmatter.name: context-sensitive-cursor
frontmatter.description: Cursor color and styling that adapt to the current text segment being typed — accent color on highlights, dim on placeholders, etc.

frontmatter.name: stat-bars-and-fills
frontmatter.description: Data-viz primitives that pair a number with a graphic — growth bars (CSS scaleY stagger), a progress fill (bar or ring), and a partial star-rating wipe. Seek-safe, deterministic.

frontmatter.name: orbit-3d-entry
frontmatter.description: Elements flip in from 3D space then settle into continuous elliptical orbit around a focal point.

frontmatter.name: center-outward-expansion
frontmatter.description: Elements start clustered at screen center and expand outward to their final positions, driven by a shared progress value.

frontmatter.name: motion-blur-streak
frontmatter.description: Fake directional velocity blur on a fast entrance or camera push-through — blur peaks at max speed and resolves to 0 at the settle, so the element streaks in then snaps sharp. Two paths — SVG feGaussianBlur on the motion axis, or an echo/ghost trail that collapses into the lead.

frontmatter.name: 3d-page-scroll
frontmatter.description: Full webpage rendered as tilted 3D card that scrolls to reveal specific sections.

frontmatter.name: asr-keyword-glow
frontmatter.description: Keywords glow + scale up when "spoken" — attack/sustain/release envelope synced to per-word timestamps. Even without real audio, hardcoded timings create a "narrator emphasis" effect.

frontmatter.name: 3d-text-depth-layers
frontmatter.description: Multiple offset text layers create a stacked 3D shadow / extrusion effect on large typography — more impactful than CSS text-shadow because each layer is a full DOM element.

frontmatter.name: depth-scatter-assemble
frontmatter.description: N elements scatter into / reassemble from a rotating 3D depth-cloud, each starting at a deterministic index-derived 3D offset and settling to a clean flat layout.

frontmatter.name: kinetic-beat-slam
frontmatter.description: Percussive kinetic typography — short phrases slam in on a steady beat with distinct per-phrase entrances, optional rhythm chrome (metronome ticks, beat bar), then a locked finale.

frontmatter.name: reactive-displacement
frontmatter.description: Physical collision where an entering element's spring drives the exiting element's displacement — single source of truth makes the motion causally linked.

frontmatter.name: discrete-text-sequence
frontmatter.description: Replace entire text states at frame thresholds for non-linear typing effects — typos, bulk additions, pauses, backspaces, simulated thinking.

frontmatter.name: depth-of-field-blur
frontmatter.description: Selective-focus rack-focus — pull the eye to a focal element by GSAP-tweening filter blur (+ a small opacity dim) on the off-focus layers while the focal one stays sharp. Drive blur via a `--dof` CSS var; finite tweens, no CSS transition, deterministic. Covers single focal pull, rack-focus between two depth planes, and blur-the-cluster-while-pushing-in.

frontmatter.name: multi-phase-camera
frontmatter.description: Sequential camera zoom with 2-3 distinct phases (pull-back / focus / push) plus continuous micro-drift for organic cinematic feel.

frontmatter.name: vertical-spring-ticker
frontmatter.description: Slot-machine style vertical scrolling using additive spring physics within a masked container — each spring contributes one "step" of scroll.

frontmatter.name: press-release-spring
frontmatter.description: Tactile button press with linear compression, spring-based elastic recovery, and layered visual feedback (shadow shrink + release burst + background glow).

frontmatter.name: spring-pop-entrance
frontmatter.description: The canonical entrance pop — an element (or staggered group) arrives by scaling 0 → 1 on a smooth long-tail settle (power3 default); bouncy overshoot is a rare, explicitly-playful exception. fromTo so it's correct at t=0 under seek.

frontmatter.name: split-tilt-cards
frontmatter.description: Two cards side-by-side with opposing Y-rotation creating a symmetric 3D split-screen layout for comparisons or feature pairs.

frontmatter.name: camera-cursor-tracking
frontmatter.description: Two-phase virtual camera that locks viewport to a moving focal point with configurable initial positioning.

frontmatter.name: ambient-glow-bloom
frontmatter.description: Un-triggered soft radial glow that blooms in behind a hero element and holds with a bounded idle breathe, or a single-pass traveling sweep across a surface. No click, no word-sync — it just blooms. Finite, deterministic, seek-safe.

frontmatter.name: viewport-change
frontmatter.description: Virtual camera — simulate zoom / pan / focus-lock by transforming a wrapper around all scene content. Camera moves right → world translates left.

frontmatter.name: coordinate-target-zoom
frontmatter.description: Zoom into a specific non-centered element by combining scale with counter-translation — target ends at viewport center after the zoom completes.
